Argaladeva
disciple of Śrutakīrti (a. of Rāghavapāṇḍavīya). JRAS. NS. XV. p. 309.

Argalākavaca
(Argala an. Kavaca ?). BISM. v.. 582/7. See below Argalāstava.

Argalākīlaka
Oxf. II. 1474 (3). See Argalāstava below.

Argalāstava

MT. 1269 (e) (fol. 24-27. fr.). Mysore I. p. 198. Oxf. II. 1106. 1473 (2). 1474 (2). Petrograd 14b. RASB. VIII. A. 6413. 6414 (with Kīlaka). Śg. II. 234. Stein 231. Taylor I. p. 241. Trav. Uni. 5514B. 14019B. Udaipur I. B. 131, 68 (p. 8. no. 978 of Pt.. Cat.). Ujjain II. p. 95. Whish 42.
